# DevSnips

> Open-source, framework-free frontend component library. Tailwind, Vanilla, and React components, sections, and full page templates.

Sitemap: https://devsnips.dev/sitemap.xml
Search index (JSON): https://devsnips.dev/search-index.json

## Tailwind
### Components
- [Basic Accordion](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Accordions/basic-accordion/index.html): Simple documentation accordion with chevron rotation and smooth height animation. Clean, accessible, and ready for knowledge bases and developer docs. Tags: accordion, basic, documentation, collapsible, faq, expandable.
- [Bordered Accordion](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Accordions/bordered-accordion/index.html): Enterprise accordion with distinct bordered cards, leading status icons, status chips, and metadata grids. Each section is self-contained for compliance and admin panels. Tags: accordion, bordered, enterprise, admin, compliance, cards.
- [Dark Accordion](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Accordions/dark-accordion/index.html): Modern dark-mode dashboard accordion with single-open behavior, glowing status dots, metric delta badges, and an indigo active accent. Built for analytics and admin panels. Tags: accordion, dark, dashboard, analytics, single-open, metrics.
- [FAQ Accordion](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Accordions/faq-accordion/index.html): Landing-page FAQ with numbered badges, category chips, and single-open behavior. Includes a smooth height animation and a contact CTA for product pages. Tags: accordion, faq, landing, single-open, numbered, product.
- [Glass Accordion](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Accordions/glass-accordion/index.html): Glassmorphism accordion with frosted translucent panels, hairline white borders, and soft glow over a vivid gradient backdrop. Ideal for hero and AI product sections. Tags: accordion, glass, glassmorphism, frosted, translucent, hero.
- [Icon Accordion](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Accordions/icon-accordion/index.html): Accordion with leading category icons in tinted squares and two-line headers. Panels reveal related link lists, ideal for knowledge bases and support centers. Tags: accordion, icon, knowledge-base, support, categories, links.
- [Minimal Accordion](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Accordions/minimal-accordion/index.html): Borderless, typography-led accordion with a plus/minus indicator that animates into a minus. Ultra-clean hierarchy for modern SaaS and marketing pages. Tags: accordion, minimal, clean, plus-minus, borderless, saas.
- [Multi Open Accordion](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Accordions/multi-open-accordion/index.html): Faceted filter panel where multiple sections stay open at once. Each section holds checkbox filters with a live selected-count badge for e-commerce and directory filtering. Tags: accordion, multi-open, filter, facets, checkbox, ecommerce.
- [Nested Accordion](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Accordions/nested-accordion/index.html): Two-level documentation tree. Chapters expand to reveal page lists, and individual pages open nested sub-lists with a connector line. Sidebar-chevron rotates 90 degrees. Tags: accordion, nested, documentation, tree, navigation, sidebar.
- [Pricing FAQ](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Accordions/pricing-faq/index.html): Pricing-page FAQ grouped by plan tier with tier-colored section badges and upgrade CTAs inside answers. Single-open behavior keeps the focus on one question at a time. Tags: accordion, pricing, faq, plans, saas, single-open.
- [Settings Accordion](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Accordions/settings-accordion/index.html): Application settings accordion whose panels hold form controls, toggles, and a danger zone. Single-open sections grouped like a real settings page. Tags: accordion, settings, forms, toggles, admin, account.
- [Sidebar Accordion](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Accordions/sidebar-accordion/index.html): Documentation navigation sidebar where category groups expand to reveal link lists with an active-page marker and connector line. Multi-open so readers keep context while browsing. Tags: accordion, sidebar, navigation, docs, multi-open, links.
- [Single Open Accordion](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Accordions/single-open-accordion/index.html): Generic accordion enforcing one-open-at-a-time behavior with an expanding accent bar and a live open-count announcement. For terms, policies, and focused help centers. Tags: accordion, single-open, exclusive, policy, help-center, accessibility.
- [Timeline Accordion](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Accordions/timeline-accordion/index.html): Expandable project timeline rendered as a vertical-rail accordion. Each milestone shows date, status dot, and an expandable panel with deliverables and progress. Tags: accordion, timeline, milestones, roadmap, project, status.
- [3D Button Colored](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Buttons/3d-button-colored/index.html): Colored 3D buttons with gradients Tags: button, 3d, gradient, colored, push.
- [Animated Arrow Button](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Buttons/animated-button-arrow/index.html): Arrow slide animations on hover for navigation Tags: button, animated, arrow, hover, navigation.
- [Animated Icon Button](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Buttons/animated-button-icon/index.html): Icon animations on hover for interactive effects Tags: button, animated, icon, hover.
- [Animated Loading Button](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Buttons/animated-button-loading/index.html): Loading state animations with spinner icons Tags: button, animated, loading, spinner.
- [Animated Scale Button](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Buttons/animated-button-scale/index.html): Scale animations on hover for interactive feedback Tags: button, animated, scale, hover, transform.
- [Animated Shine Button](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Buttons/animated-button-shine/index.html): Shine sweep animations on hover for premium feel Tags: button, animated, shine, sweep, premium.
- [Full Width Button](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Buttons/basic-button-full-width/index.html): Full width buttons for mobile views and prominent call-to-action sections Tags: button, full width, mobile, cta.
- [Neutral Button](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Buttons/basic-button-neutral/index.html): Neutral buttons designed for dark backgrounds with light and dark variants Tags: button, neutral, dark, dark mode.
- [Primary Button](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Buttons/basic-button-primary/index.html): Primary action buttons with semantic blue color and default, disabled, and link states Tags: button, primary, basic, solid.
- [Secondary Button](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Buttons/basic-button-secondary/index.html): Secondary action buttons with gray, indigo, and violet color options Tags: button, secondary, gray, indigo, violet.
- [Button Sizes](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Buttons/basic-button-sizes/index.html): Button sizes from extra small to extra large for different use cases Tags: button, sizes, small, large, responsive.
- [Soft Background Button](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Buttons/filled-button-soft/index.html): Soft background buttons with pastel colors for subtle actions Tags: button, filled, soft, pastel, subtle.
- [Floating Action Button Extended](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Buttons/floating-action-button-extended/index.html): Extended FAB with icon and text Tags: button, fab, floating, action, extended.
- [Floating Action Button Group](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Buttons/floating-action-button-group/index.html): Grouped FABs for multiple actions Tags: button, fab, floating, action, group.
- [Floating Action Button Standard](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Buttons/floating-action-button-standard/index.html): Standard floating action buttons (FAB) Tags: button, fab, floating, action, icon.
- [Ghost Primary Button](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Buttons/ghost-button-primary/index.html): Transparent buttons with blue hover background effect Tags: button, ghost, transparent, hover.
- [Glass Icon Button](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Buttons/glass-button-icon/index.html): Glass morphism icon buttons for toolbars and actions Tags: button, glass, glassmorphism, icon.
- [Glass Soft Button](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Buttons/glass-button-soft/index.html): Soft glass morphism buttons with blur effect Tags: button, glass, glassmorphism, blur, frosted.

Selecting a card reveals its feature panel. Ideal for plan pickers. Tags: tabs, cards, pricing, plans, selection, radio.
- [Dashboard Tabs](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Tabs/dashboard-tabs/index.html): Analytics dashboard tabs switching metric panels (revenue, traffic, conversion, audience). Includes KPI cards, trend deltas, and a simple bar chart. Tags: tabs, dashboard, analytics, kpi, charts, metrics.
- [Icon Tabs](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Tabs/icon-tabs/index.html): Settings tabs with prominent icons in a responsive grid. Active tab highlights its icon container. Great for account, security, and billing configuration. Tags: tabs, icons, settings, account, grid, responsive.
- [Mobile Tabs](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Tabs/mobile-tabs/index.html): Bottom mobile tab navigation bar with icons, labels, and a notification badge. Switches app screens within a phone-style frame. Built for native-feeling mobile web apps. Tags: tabs, mobile, bottom-nav, app, icons, navigation.
- [Pill Tabs](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Tabs/pill-tabs/index.html): SaaS dashboard pill tabs with count badges for customer segments. Filled active pill, outlined inactive pills, and a contextual action toolbar. Tags: tabs, pill, saas, dashboard, crm, badges.
- [Scrollable Tabs](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Tabs/scrollable-tabs/index.html): Horizontal scrollable category tabs with fade edges and hidden scrollbar for mobile marketplaces. Active tab auto-scrolls into view. Built for many categories on small screens. Tags: tabs, scrollable, categories, mobile, ecommerce, horizontal-scroll.
- [Segmented Tabs](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Tabs/segmented-tabs/index.html): iOS-style segmented control with a sliding indicator that animates between segments. Used for switching time ranges and compact view modes. Tags: tabs, segmented, ios, slider, indicator, control.
- [Settings Tabs](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Tabs/settings-tabs/index.html): Full settings page with a vertical nav tab list and content panels including general, account, appearance, integrations, and a danger zone. Tags: tabs, settings, vertical, forms, danger-zone, appearance.
- [Underline Tabs](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Tabs/underline-tabs/index.html): Modern developer documentation tabs with a moving underline indicator, version badge, and embedded code samples. Built for docs sites and API references. Tags: tabs, underline, documentation, developer, api, code.
- [Vertical Tabs](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Tabs/vertical-tabs/index.html): Documentation sidebar with vertical tabs controlling article content. Collapses to a horizontal scroll on mobile. Ideal for docs sites and onboarding flows. Tags: tabs, vertical, sidebar, documentation, onboarding.
- [Action Toast](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Toasts/action-toast/index.html): Toast with an inline action button (Undo). Fires an onAction callback when the action button is clicked, otherwise auto-dismisses after 6 seconds. Ideal for reversible destructive actions like delete. Tags: toast, notification, undo, action, destructive, feedback, reversible.
- [Glass Toast](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Toasts/glass-toast/index.html): Frosted-glass notification toasts in the glassmorphism design language — translucent backdrop-blur panels with semantic glowing accents, a live countdown progress bar, and pause-on-hover, presented over an animated aurora mesh backdrop. Tags: toast, notification, glassmorphism, glass, aurora, dark, countdown, feedback.
- [Minimal Toast](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Toasts/minimal-toast/index.html): Compact pill-shaped toast for terse, icon-led feedback like "Copied!" or "Saved". No body text — just an icon and a label. Appears centered at the bottom and fades after 2 seconds. Tags: toast, notification, minimal, compact, pill, copied, inline, feedback.
- [Persistent Toast](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Toasts/persistent-toast/index.html): Toast that stays open until explicitly dismissed, with a shrinking progress bar showing the remaining time. The bar pauses on hover and resumes on leave. Ideal for upload results and important notices that shouldn't be missed. Tags: toast, notification, persistent, progress, countdown, upload, feedback.
- [Promise Toast](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Toasts/promise-toast/index.html): Async-operation toast that opens in a loading state and transitions in place to success or error when a promise settles. Pass any promise to showPromiseToast() with loading/success/error copy; once settled it auto-dismisses behind a pause-on-hover countdown bar. Tags: toast, notification, promise, async, loading, neo-brutal.
- [Stacked Toasts](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Toasts/stacked-toasts/index.html): Notification queue that stacks incoming toasts vertically. New toasts push older ones up with a staggered slide-in, and each clears itself on its own 5-second timer. Includes a dismiss-all control. Tags: toast, notification, stack, queue, feed, activity, multiple.
- [Status Toasts](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Toasts/status-toasts/index.html): Four semantic toast variants — success, error, warning, info — each with a matching icon, accent color, and ARIA role. Errors and warnings use role=alert; success and info use role=status. Tags: toast, notification, success, error, warning, info, feedback, alert.
- [Delayed Tooltip](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Tooltips/delayed-tooltip/index.html): Tooltip that waits 600ms before appearing on hover so quick mouse-overs don't flicker, then hides instantly on exit. Uses CSS transition-delay - no JavaScript timers. Appears instantly on keyboard focus. Tags: tooltip, delay, hover, transition-delay, css-only, anti-flicker.
- [Directional Tooltip](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Tooltips/directional-tooltip/index.html): Tooltips in all four directions - top, right, bottom, left - with arrows that reposition automatically. Direction is controlled by the data-tooltip-pos attribute. Pure CSS, no JavaScript. Tags: tooltip, direction, position, arrow, top, right, bottom, left, css-only.
- [Hotspot Tooltip](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Tooltips/hotspot-tooltip/index.html): Onboarding hotspot beacon that opens a multi-step guided tour tooltip. Click the pulsing beacon to start; Next/Done walk the steps, Skip or Escape dismiss it. Tags: tooltip, hotspot, tour, onboarding, beacon, minimal-vercel.
- [Icon Tooltip](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Tooltips/icon-tooltip/index.html): Tooltip on an icon-only button - the key accessibility use case where the tooltip serves as the visible label. Each icon button carries aria-label and a role=tooltip companion so screen readers announce the action. Pure CSS. Tags: tooltip, icon, icon-button, label, accessibility, toolbar, css-only.
- [Rich Tooltip](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Tooltips/rich-tooltip/index.html): Wide tooltip with rich content - a title plus a multi-line description - ideal for help text on form fields and complex UI elements. Pure CSS using two data attributes, hover or focus to reveal. Tags: tooltip, rich, help, multiline, form, css-only, accessibility.
- [Selection Toolbar](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Tooltips/selection-toolbar/index.html): A floating toolbar that appears above any selected text inside its article scope, offering Highlight (real <mark> wrap), Copy, and Share actions. Positions itself over the selection with viewport clamping and re-tracks on scroll and resize. Tags: tooltip, selection, toolbar, neo-brutal, highlight, annotation.
- [Status Tooltip](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Components/Tooltips/status-tooltip/index.html): Status indicator dot with a color-themed tooltip - success (green), warning (amber), error (red), info (blue). The tooltip background and arrow match the semantic status. Pure CSS, hover or focus to reveal. Tags: tooltip, status, indicator, dot, success, warning, error, info, css-only.

### Templates
- [AI SaaS Platform](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Templates/ai-saas-platform/index.html): 
- [Atlas Analytics Platform](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Templates/atlas-analytics/index.html): A flagship 11-page Tailwind CSS product-analytics application template for Atlas Analytics, a fictional enterprise analytics platform. A minimal, light, editorial, data-dense design language — white canvas, near-black text, 1px hairline borders, small radii, restrained shadows and a single controlled blue accent. Eleven independently-usable pages (overview, analytics explorer, funnels, cohorts, retention, revenue, reports, dashboards, segments, events, settings) share one Atlas shell (sticky topbar + fixed sidebar + calm dark-mode toggle). All charts are hand-built inline SVG; Tailwind CDN + scoped vanilla JS, fully responsive from 320px up, no build step.
- [Baseline Design & Engineering Conference](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Templates/baseline-conference/index.html): A premium multi-page website template for a design & engineering conference, built in a bold Neo-Brutalist design system. Six connected pages (home, speakers, schedule, venue, register, code of conduct) sharing one cream + black + bright-accent language with hard borders and offset shadows. Tailwind CDN + vanilla JS, fully responsive from 320px up.
- [DevSnips Curated Design Store](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Templates/devsnips-store/index.html): A premium six-page Tailwind CSS ecommerce template for DevSnips, a fictional curated store of considered design objects. Editorial Modern meets Monochrome Luxury — a warm neutral palette (ink, paper, bone, cream) with a single clay accent, a high-contrast Fraunces serif for display, Inter for body and JetBrains Mono for labels. Six connected pages (home, shop, product, cart, checkout, journal) plus an about/atelier page share one design system of hairline rules, square geometry and generous whitespace. Tailwind CDN + scoped vanilla JS, fully responsive from 320px up.
- [Krat Adventure Wilderness](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Templates/krat-adventure/index.html): A cinematic wilderness landing page inspired by premium outdoor editorial campaigns, combining oversized typography, saturated photography, asymmetrical adventure cards, field-note details, and a deep navy palette.
- [Meridian Incident Command Platform](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Templates/meridian/index.html): A premium single-page Tailwind CSS template for an incident command platform built for on-call engineering teams. Neo-Industrial utility language meets Swiss Minimal discipline — 1px hairline rules, graph-paper blueprint surfaces, Space Grotesk display type, JetBrains Mono metadata, a hand-built incident command-surface hero with a live latency sparkline and floating signal/escalation cards, a directed alert-routing graph visualization, a five-step incident lifecycle workflow, dark customer-outcome metrics, engineer testimonials, per-on-call-team pricing, a scoped single-open FAQ accordion, and a dark corner-tick conversion CTA.
- [Northline Atelier Architecture Studio](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Templates/northline-atelier/index.html): A premium four-page architecture studio template pairing an editorial grid with warm neutrals, quiet typography, generous whitespace, and restrained interactions. Built as a responsive Tailwind CSS site without local assets.
- [Quiet Place](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Templates/quiet-place/index.html): A calm, illustration-led Tailwind landing page inspired by a quiet lakeside sanctuary, pairing a muted mint canvas, condensed editorial typography, soft coral CTAs, and a detailed inline SVG pixel-art landscape.
- [Stratum Fintech Ops Platform](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Templates/stratum/index.html): A premium single-page Tailwind CSS template for a vertical fintech operations platform. Neo-Brutalist geometry meets editorial typography — thick 2px borders, offset hard shadows, Archivo display type, JetBrains Mono metadata, a hand-built treasury command-surface hero with live sparkline, an approval-routing graph visualization, staggered pillar cards, a bento capabilities grid, a five-step workflow, customer-outcome metrics, testimonial proof, cash-managed pricing, a scoped single-open FAQ accordion, and a dark conversion CTA.
- [Vesper Attack-Surface Management Platform](https://devsnips.dev/Tailwind/Templates/vesper/index.html): A premium single-page Tailwind CSS template for an external attack-surface management platform built for security teams. Glassmorphism surfaces meet Cyber Minimal discipline — translucent frosted panels over an atmospheric fuchsia/indigo/cyan mesh, Sora display type, JetBrains Mono metadata, a hand-built attack-surface command-console hero with a live surface radar and sparkline plus floating critical-exposure/new-asset mini-cards, a signature asset-topology reachability graph with an exposed path highlighted in cyan, a five-step signed-state EASM lifecycle workflow, dark customer-outcome metrics, security-leader testimonials, per-asset pricing, a scoped single-open FAQ accordion, and a glass conversion CTA with a three-step onboarding panel.

### Templates
- [Agency](https://devsnips.dev/Vanilla/Templates/agency/index.html): A premium editorial agency website template for DevSnips built with semantic HTML, CSS (Pico CSS foundation), and vanilla JavaScript. A dark-first, high-contrast editorial layout combining bold typography, an asymmetric hero, an about + statistics section, an editorial services list, selected work with alternating project layouts, a featured case study, a five-step process, a capabilities grid, a team grid, testimonials, an insights/blog section, and a contact CTA, plus a sticky header with responsive mobile navigation, scroll-reveal animations, and scrollspy active navigation. Split into modular files: code.html + style.css + script.js, with preview.html as a self-contained single-file preview. Follows the shared design-tokens.md system.
- [Developer Portfolio](https://devsnips.dev/Vanilla/Templates/developer-portfolio/index.html): A personal, technical, editorial-minimal portfolio template for a software / design engineer, built with semantic HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript. Light, neutral, and typography-driven: a sticky header with brand mark, anchor nav, theme toggle, and a responsive mobile drawer; an editorial intro with a clamp() lead, status badge, and metadata grid; a selected-work list of project cards (index, title, role, year, description, stack tags, case-study link); an about/capabilities split with a capability table and a four-up stat row; a notes/writing list with date + category meta; and a contact section with a lead, channels list, and footer. Split into modular files: code.html (HTML structure) + style.css (the design system, following the shared design-tokens.md --ds-* token layer with light-default + calm opt-in dark mode and reduced-motion guard) + script.js (theme toggle, mobile nav, scrollspy active nav, IntersectionObserver reveal), with preview.html as a self-contained single-file preview. No React, Vue, Next.js, Tailwind, Bootstrap, or backend.
- [Documentation Site](https://devsnips.dev/Vanilla/Templates/documentation-site/index.html): A premium, minimal, light-mode-first developer-documentation template for DevSnips built with plain HTML, CSS (Pico CSS foundation), and vanilla JavaScript. Split into modular files: code.html (HTML structure) + style.css (the design system) + script.js (router, content, interactions), with preview.html as a self-contained single-file preview of the UI. Layout: header + nested left documentation sidebar + main content + sticky On-this-page TOC. Covers 15 documentation sections (Documentation Home, Introduction, Getting Started, Installation, Quick Start, Vanilla, Components, Templates, Design Tokens, Guides, API Reference, Examples, FAQ, Changelog, Roadmap, Contributing) via hash routing. Includes nested sidebar navigation with active page state, breadcrumbs, sticky scrollspy table of contents, previous/next navigation, a Cmd+K search command palette, code blocks with a lightweight syntax highlighter, copy buttons, tabbed code blocks, callouts, responsive tables, badges, API reference blocks, an edit-on-GitHub action, last-updated metadata, and opt-in light/dark mode. Neutral-first design with one blue accent (never violet/neon), hairline borders, restrained shadows, light code blocks, and editorial typography — following the shared design-tokens.md specification. Fully responsive: sidebar becomes an off-canvas drawer, TOC becomes a collapsible panel, code blocks remain usable, tables adapt without page overflow, from 320px to 1920px. No React, Vue, Next.js, Tailwind, Bootstrap, backend, database, or CMS.
- [Event Conference](https://devsnips.dev/Vanilla/Templates/event-conference/index.html): A dense, structured single-track conference website template built with semantic HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript. Light, neutral, and typography-driven: a sticky header with brand mark, date, anchor nav, theme toggle, and responsive mobile drawer; an editorial hero with a clamp() headline, facts grid (dates / location / talks / capacity), and a live countdown card; an about section with highlights table and a four-up stat row; a speakers grid (avatar initials, name, role, talk); a two-day schedule with an ARIA tablist (arrow-key nav, Home/End) and a time-rail slot list; a venue section with details table; a capped sponsorship tier list; and a three-tier register panel (early-bird / standard / workshop) + footer. Split into modular files: code.html + style.css (the --ds-* design-token system from design-tokens.md, light-default + calm opt-in dark mode, reduced-motion guard) + script.js (theme toggle, mobile nav, schedule tabs, live countdown, reveal), with preview.html as a self-contained single-file preview. No React, Vue, Next.js, Tailwind, Bootstrap, or backend.
- [HTML5 Boilerplate](https://devsnips.dev/Vanilla/Templates/html5-boilerplate/index.html): A minimal, clean HTML5 starter template aligned with the DevSnips design system. A single self-contained index.html with the doctype, head, and body, plus the core --ds-* design-token foundation (light-default + calm opt-in dark mode via [data-theme="dark"]), a no-flash pre-paint theme script, system-font stack (Inter + JetBrains Mono with fallbacks), box-sizing reset, :focus-visible ring, and a prefers-reduced-motion guard. Intentionally bare so a new page can build on the shared token base from the first line. No framework, no build step, no external dependencies.
- [Job Board](https://devsnips.dev/Vanilla/Templates/job-board/index.html): A dense, structured developer job-board template for DevSnips built with semantic HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript. Light, neutral, and information-dense: a sticky navigation bar with a responsive mobile menu, a jobs view with keyword search plus location and job-type filters, category chips, a result count, and a paginated job list; a job detail view with company sidebar (apply / save) and a details sidebar; a companies directory grid and a company detail view with open positions; a saved jobs view with an empty state; and a candidate area with a sidebar and profile, applications (status table), and saved-jobs tabs. Includes a scoped apply modal, toast notifications, and a mobile filter drawer. Split into modular files: code.html (HTML structure) + style.css (the design system, following the shared design-tokens.md --ds-* token layer with an opt-in dark mode and reduced-motion guard) + script.js (all views, rendering, filtering, pagination, save/apply, and interactions), with preview.html as a self-contained single-file preview of the UI. No React, Vue, Next.js, Tailwind, Bootstrap, backend, database, or job-posting API.
- [Product Launch](https://devsnips.dev/Vanilla/Templates/product-launch/index.html): A clean, restrained product launch / waitlist landing page for a dev-focused product, built with semantic HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript. Light, neutral, and typography-driven: a sticky header with brand mark, anchor nav, theme toggle, and responsive mobile drawer; an editorial hero with a clamp() headline, status meta, and a working waitlist card (name + email validation, simulated submission, success state, beta-capacity progress bar); a social-proof logo row; a three-column feature grid; a four-step how-it-works list; a two-plan pricing teaser; a single-open FAQ accordion (CSS-grid 0fr->1fr, aria-expanded/controls/region); and a final CTA panel + footer. Split into modular files: code.html + style.css (the --ds-* design-token system from design-tokens.md, light-default + calm opt-in dark mode, reduced-motion guard) + script.js (theme toggle, mobile nav, accordion, waitlist form validation, reveal), with preview.html as a self-contained single-file preview. No React, Vue, Next.js, Tailwind, Bootstrap, or backend.
- [SaaS Dashboard](https://devsnips.dev/Vanilla/Templates/saas-dashboard/index.html): A complete, commercial-grade Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS SaaS dashboard template: 30 interconnected pages sharing one coherent mock dataset, a JS-injected app shell, and a single Northstar design system. Covers overview (dashboard, analytics, reports, activity), customer management (customers, details, activity, segments, invitations), revenue (billing, plans, payment methods, invoices, transactions), communication (3-panel inbox, notifications, preferences), workspace (team, roles & permissions matrix, integrations, settings), settings (general, profile, security, sessions, API keys, webhooks), and support (help center, support, system status). Includes interactive SVG charts, sortable/paginated/filterable tables with bulk selection, modals, drawers, toasts, loading/empty/error states, light/dark mode, and a responsive sidebar that becomes an off-canvas drawer. No frameworks, no build step, no backend.

## React
### Components
- [Accordion](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Accordion/accordion/index.html): The reference accordion: single-expansion disclosure built from the shared compound primitives — real button triggers in headings, `aria-expanded`/`aria-controls` wiring, grid-rows height animation, and a clean border-divided list treatment. Every other variant in the family is built from these same primitives. Tags: accordion, disclosure, react, tailwind, accessible, responsive, tokens, reference, single, compound, disclosure.
- [Bordered Accordion](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Accordion/accordion-bordered/index.html): The contained treatment: the same accordion framed in a `radius-md` bordered surface — an alternate structure for settings panels and cards, driven entirely by the root's `className`. The trigger's inset focus ring is what makes this work: it is never clipped by the container's `overflow-hidden`. Tags: accordion, disclosure, react, tailwind, accessible, responsive, tokens, bordered, contained, layout, surface.
- [Collapsible Accordion](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Accordion/accordion-collapsible/index.html): Single-expansion mode with `collapsible`: the open item can be closed again by activating its trigger, so zero or one items are open. Shown side-by-side with the default mandatory behavior, where activating the open item's trigger is a no-op and exactly one item stays open. Tags: accordion, disclosure, react, tailwind, accessible, responsive, tokens, collapsible, single, toggle, behavior.
- [Disabled Accordion Items](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Accordion/accordion-disabled/index.html): Items disabled at the `<AccordionItem>` level: the trigger renders as a natively disabled button — unfocusable, not activatable by pointer or keyboard, exposed as disabled to assistive technology, and skipped by Tab. Disabled items can never open. Tags: accordion, disclosure, react, tailwind, accessible, responsive, tokens, disabled, states, permissions.
- [FAQ Accordion](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Accordion/accordion-faq/index.html): A realistic frequently-asked-questions accordion: question/answer pairs with roomier region padding, body-sm answer copy, and semantic question text in the trigger (the question IS the button label — no redundant ARIA question roles). Tags: accordion, disclosure, react, tailwind, accessible, responsive, tokens, faq, questions, support, content.
- [Loading Accordion](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Accordion/accordion-loading/index.html): A region that loads asynchronously: while data is pending the content area renders geometry-preserving skeleton bars (aria-hidden) with an sr-only announcement and `aria-busy` on the region — then swaps to the real data without a layout jump. The pulse is disabled under reduced motion. Tags: accordion, disclosure, react, tailwind, accessible, responsive, tokens, loading, skeleton, aria-busy, async.
- [Multiple Accordion](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Accordion/accordion-multiple/index.html): Multiple-expansion mode: any number of items can stay open at once. `value` and `onValueChange` become `string[]` — the TypeScript types are discriminated by `type="multiple"`, so the compiler enforces the array shape. Includes a controlled demo with external Expand all / Collapse all actions. Tags: accordion, disclosure, react, tailwind, accessible, responsive, tokens, multiple, controlled, uncontrolled, state.
- [Nested Accordion](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Accordion/accordion-nested/index.html): An accordion inside an accordion's region: each `<Accordion>` instance owns an independent state and id base (via `useId`), so nested items toggle without touching the parent, ids never collide, and keyboard behavior stays the predictable native-button model at every depth. Tags: accordion, disclosure, react, tailwind, accessible, responsive, tokens, nested, independent state, hierarchy, composite.
- [Accordion with Actions](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Accordion/accordion-with-actions/index.html): Accordion regions that contain real actions — buttons and links inside the expanded content. The trigger itself stays a single clean button (no nested controls); actions live in the region, where they are fully keyboard reachable and operable while the item is open. Tags: accordion, disclosure, react, tailwind, accessible, responsive, tokens, actions, buttons, links, composite.
- [Accordion with Badge](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Accordion/accordion-with-badge/index.html): Triggers with a status or count badge via the `badge` prop — a neutral token-styled pill pinned before the chevron. The badge is plain, non-interactive text inside the button: it never intercepts clicks and never creates a confusing accessible name. Tags: accordion, disclosure, react, tailwind, accessible, responsive, tokens, badge, status, count, pill.
- [Accordion with Description](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Accordion/accordion-with-description/index.html): Triggers with a title plus a short supporting line via the `description` prop — a muted 13px second row under the title that keeps a clean two-level hierarchy. Useful for documentation and settings sections where the title alone is ambiguous. Tags: accordion, disclosure, react, tailwind, accessible, responsive, tokens, description, two-line trigger, docs, hierarchy.
- [Accordion with Icons](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Accordion/accordion-with-icons/index.html): Triggers with a leading icon via the `icon` prop — a ReactNode rendered in a fixed 16px `aria-hidden` slot. Icons supplement the trigger text (settings sections with recognizable glyphs); they never replace it, so the accessible name always comes from real text. Tags: accordion, disclosure, react, tailwind, accessible, responsive, tokens, icons, leading-icon, settings.
- [Alert](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Alerts/alert/index.html): The reference alert: a restrained inline feedback surface (radius-md, 1px border) with the title / description / icon / action / close primitives and role-matched live-region behavior. Every other variant in the family is built from these same primitives. Tags: alert, feedback, react, tailwind, accessible, responsive, tokens, reference, compound, composition, status.
- [Compact Alert](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Alerts/alert-compact/index.html): The `size="sm"` density: reduced padding and gaps for dense interfaces — settings panels, inspector sidebars, data-dense admin screens — while keeping the full compound API, roles, and wrapping behavior. Tags: alert, feedback, react, tailwind, accessible, responsive, tokens, compact, dense, size, density.
- [Destructive Alert](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Alerts/alert-destructive/index.html): Failures and blocking errors: a red tint derived from the `color.destructive` token, the error glyph, and an assertive `role="alert"` — for failed operations and validation summaries the user must resolve. Tags: alert, feedback, react, tailwind, accessible, responsive, tokens, destructive, error, alert-role, assertive, validation.
- [Dismissible Alert](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Alerts/alert-dismissible/index.html): An alert the user can dismiss: a real close button with an accessible name, controlled (`open` + `onDismiss`) or uncontrolled (`defaultOpen`) state, and focus management that never strands keyboard users when the alert unmounts. Tags: alert, feedback, react, tailwind, accessible, responsive, tokens, dismissible, close, controlled, uncontrolled, focus management.
- [Info Alert](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Alerts/alert-info/index.html): Informational feedback: a neutral-blue tint derived from the `color.info` token, the info glyph, and a polite `role="status"` — for neutral, non-urgent messages the user should know about but does not have to act on. Tags: alert, feedback, react, tailwind, accessible, responsive, tokens, info, informational, status, polite.
- [Live-Region Alert](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Alerts/alert-live/index.html): Dynamic application feedback done right: alerts mounted on the event announce through their role — `role="status"` politely for outcomes, `role="alert"` assertively for failures — with one live region per message so nothing is announced twice. Tags: alert, feedback, react, tailwind, accessible, responsive, tokens, live region, aria-live, async, status, dynamic.
- [Rich Alert](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Alerts/alert-rich/index.html): The full composition: semantic icon, title, description, action row, and a dismiss button working together — the shape for product updates and operational incidents that carry both context and next steps. Tags: alert, feedback, react, tailwind, accessible, responsive, tokens, rich, composite, actions, dismissible, full composition.
- [Success Alert](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Alerts/alert-success/index.html): Confirmation of a completed operation: a green tint derived from the `color.success` token, the check glyph, and a polite `role="status"` — for "it worked" feedback after saves, payments, backups, and syncs. Tags: alert, feedback, react, tailwind, accessible, responsive, tokens, success, confirmation, status, polite.
- [Warning Alert](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Alerts/alert-warning/index.html): Caution that needs attention before it becomes a failure: an amber tint derived from the `color.warning` token, the triangle glyph, and an assertive `role="alert"` — for quota, deprecation, and expiring-access messages. Tags: alert, feedback, react, tailwind, accessible, responsive, tokens, warning, caution, alert-role, assertive.
- [Alert with Action](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Alerts/alert-with-action/index.html): An alert with real action buttons in the `AlertAction` row — for messages that ask the user to do something: upgrade, retry, update billing. Actions are native `<button>` elements and wrap below the text at narrow widths. Tags: alert, feedback, react, tailwind, accessible, responsive, tokens, action, button, cta, composite.
- [Alert with Icon](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Alerts/alert-with-icon/index.html): The leading icon slot in detail: semantic variants render their status glyph automatically, the `icon` prop replaces it with any `ReactNode`, and `icon={null}` suppresses it — the icon is always decorative to assistive technology. Tags: alert, feedback, react, tailwind, accessible, responsive, tokens, icon, glyph, semantic icon, composition.
- [Alert with Link](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Alerts/alert-with-link/index.html): An alert containing real anchors — an inline link inside the description, or a link in the action row. Links navigate, so they are `<a href>` elements with normal browser behavior, never click handlers on text. Tags: alert, feedback, react, tailwind, accessible, responsive, tokens, link, anchor, navigation, composite.
- [Breadcrumbs](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Breadcrumbs/breadcrumbs/index.html): Accessible breadcrumb navigation as a compound component: semantic nav landmark, ordered list, real anchor links, and an aria-current current page. Tags: breadcrumbs, navigation, react, tailwind, accessible, responsive, links, hierarchy.
- [Breadcrumbs Collapsed](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Breadcrumbs/breadcrumbs-collapsed/index.html): Long breadcrumb paths with middle levels collapsed behind an accessible ellipsis disclosure — the hidden levels stay reachable as real links from a keyboard-operable menu. Tags: breadcrumbs, navigation, react, tailwind, accessible, responsive, links, hierarchy, collapse, ellipsis, keyboard, interactive, long-paths.
- [Breadcrumbs Max Width](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Breadcrumbs/breadcrumbs-max-width/index.html): Breadcrumb trail that bounds long labels with max-width truncation while keeping the full text available through the title attribute — no clipped, meaningless navigation. Tags: breadcrumbs, navigation, react, tailwind, accessible, responsive, links, hierarchy, truncation, max-width, long-labels.
- [Breadcrumbs With Current](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Breadcrumbs/breadcrumbs-with-current/index.html): Breadcrumb trail that explicitly distinguishes the current location: aria-current page text that is never a navigable link, via BreadcrumbCurrent or the current prop for data-driven trails. Tags: breadcrumbs, navigation, react, tailwind, accessible, responsive, links, hierarchy, current-page, aria-current.
- [Breadcrumbs With Dropdown](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Breadcrumbs/breadcrumbs-with-dropdown/index.html): Breadcrumb trail where one level opens a keyboard-accessible menu of related pages — a real menu button with aria-haspopup and aria-expanded, containing real anchor links. Tags: breadcrumbs, navigation, react, tailwind, accessible, responsive, links, hierarchy, dropdown, menu, keyboard, interactive.
- [Breadcrumbs With Home](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Breadcrumbs/breadcrumbs-with-home/index.html): Breadcrumb trail whose first level is the application home, rendered with a meaningful home icon that stays hidden from screen readers when a visible label is present. Tags: breadcrumbs, navigation, react, tailwind, accessible, responsive, links, hierarchy, icon, home.
- [Breadcrumbs With Icons](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Breadcrumbs/breadcrumbs-with-icons/index.html): Breadcrumb levels with optional meaningful leading icons — passed as ReactNode, rendered aria-hidden, and never required on every item. Tags: breadcrumbs, navigation, react, tailwind, accessible, responsive, links, hierarchy, icon.
- [Breadcrumbs With Separator](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Breadcrumbs/breadcrumbs-with-separator/index.html): Breadcrumb trail with a configurable separator: set one separator node on the root for the whole trail, or override a single position — separators stay decorative and aria-hidden. Tags: breadcrumbs, navigation, react, tailwind, accessible, responsive, links, hierarchy, separator.
- [Add Button](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Buttons/add-button/index.html): A creation affordance with a leading plus. `label` is both the visible text and (when icon-only) the accessible name. Defaults to solid since adding is often the primary creation action on a surface. Tags: button, react, tailwind, add, create, utility, action, interactive.
- [Back Button](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Buttons/back-button/index.html): Returns to the previous view. Leading arrow-left + label. Renders as a button (onClick, default) or a link (href). Icon-only mode needs a `label` prop for the accessible name. Tags: button, react, tailwind, back, navigation, interactive.
- [Button Group](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Buttons/button-group/index.html): A joined row of related buttons. Inner buttons share borders (side radius removed, borders overlapped by 1px) so the group reads as one control. Pass children for full control, or the `items` prop for a quick group. Tags: button, react, tailwind, group, composite, toolbar, interactive.
- [Button With Chevron](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Buttons/button-with-chevron/index.html): A labeled button with a trailing chevron. `direction` controls orientation (down for menus/disclosure, right for advancing), and `open` rotates a down chevron to signal an expanded state. Tags: button, react, tailwind, chevron, menu, disclosure, composite, interactive.
- [Button With Icon](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Buttons/button-with-icon/index.html): A labeled button with a leading or trailing icon. Icons use the shared size token for the chosen button size, with the standard control gap keeping icon and label optically aligned. Tags: button, react, tailwind, icon, action, composite, interactive.
- [Close Button](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Buttons/close-button/index.html): A dismiss control for overlays. Icon-only (X), requires an accessible name (defaults to "Close"). Use inside dialogs, drawers, toasts, and banners; pair with Escape handling on the owning surface. Tags: button, react, tailwind, close, dismiss, overlay, utility, interactive.
- [Command Button](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Buttons/command-button/index.html): Opens a command palette. A wide trigger with a search icon, placeholder text, and a kbd hint showing the platform shortcut. Wire `onOpen` to mount the palette; when `bindShortcut` is true, listens for the global shortcut (Cmd/Ctrl+K). Tags: button, react, tailwind, command-palette, search, shortcut, composite, interactive.
- [Copy Button](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Buttons/copy-button/index.html): Clipboard copy with transient feedback. Uses the async Clipboard API with an execCommand fallback. On success, swaps the icon to a check and the label to "Copied", then reverts. An `aria-live` region announces the copied state. Tags: button, react, tailwind, copy, clipboard, feedback, interactive.
- [Destructive Button](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Buttons/destructive-button/index.html): A destructive action for irreversible operations. Filled by default; an outline variant is available for lower-emphasis destructive controls in dense rows. Tags: button, react, tailwind, destructive, danger, delete, action, interactive.
- [Download Button](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Buttons/download-button/index.html): A direct download with progress feedback. Fires `onDownload` (wire to a real fetch/blob), surfaces a working state with a spinner, then a brief done state. Supports a `meta` line (e.g. "CSV · 2.4 MB"). Tags: button, react, tailwind, download, progress, feedback, interactive.
- [Export Button](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Buttons/export-button/index.html): A menu trigger for export destinations. `formats` is a list of export targets; opens a keyboard-navigable menu (aria-haspopup="menu"). Arrow keys move, Enter exports, Escape closes. Tags: button, react, tailwind, export, menu, table, toolbar, interactive.
- [Filter Button](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Buttons/filter-button/index.html): Opens filters and shows the active count. `activeCount` renders a count chip and switches the button to `surface-active` so the filtered state is obvious. `open` rotates the leading icon and exposes `aria-expanded`. Tags: button, react, tailwind, filter, count, toolbar, utility, interactive.
- [Floating Action Button](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Buttons/floating-action-button/index.html): A primary compose action hovering over content. Circular, elevated (shadow-md), fixed to a corner. Icon + optional label (extended FAB). `aria-label` is required. Reserve one per screen for the primary creation action. Tags: button, react, tailwind, fab, floating, compose, navigation, interactive.
- [Ghost Button](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Buttons/ghost-button/index.html): A borderless, transparent low-emphasis button that reveals a surface only on hover. Use for tertiary or incidental actions so the primary action keeps emphasis. Tags: button, react, tailwind, ghost, tertiary, navigation, interactive.
- [Icon Button](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Buttons/icon-button/index.html): A square icon-only control. No visible label, so an accessible name is required. Matches control height; the icon slot is square (width equals height). Tags: button, react, tailwind, icon, toolbar, utility, interactive.
- [Link Button](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Buttons/link-button/index.html): A button rendered as an inline link for terse secondary actions inside forms and rows. Reads as a link but still triggers onClick; for true navigation, pass an href. Tags: button, react, tailwind, link, inline, navigation, tertiary.
- [Loading Button](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Buttons/loading-button/index.html): An action button with a first-class loading state. `loading` swaps the leading slot for a spinner, sets `aria-busy`, and disables the button so the action can't be double-fired. Tags: button, react, tailwind, loading, spinner, async, feedback, interactive.
- [More Actions Button](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Buttons/more-actions-button/index.html): An overflow menu trigger. `actions` is a list of actions; opens a keyboard-navigable menu (aria-haspopup="menu"). Destructive actions render in `destructive` color. Icon-only by default; pass `label` for the accessible name. Tags: button, react, tailwind, more, overflow, menu, composite, interactive.
- [Outline Button](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Buttons/outline-button/index.html): A bordered, transparent-fill medium-emphasis action. Pairs with a SolidButton to establish primary/secondary hierarchy on a surface. Tags: button, react, tailwind, secondary, outline, action, interactive.
- [Pagination Button](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Buttons/pagination-button/index.html): Page navigation for paginated lists and tables. Renders Prev, a windowed number set with ellipses, and Next. The active page uses `surface-active` + `aria-current="page"`. Prev/Next disable at the bounds (kept perceivable, not removed). Tags: button, react, tailwind, pagination, navigation, table, interactive.
- [Refresh Button](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Buttons/refresh-button/index.html): Re-fetch with in-flight feedback. `onRefresh` may return a Promise; while pending, the refresh icon spins (respecting reduced motion), the button is disabled, and `aria-busy` is set. Icon-only mode for compact toolbars. Tags: button, react, tailwind, refresh, reload, feedback, interactive, icon.
- [Secondary Button](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Buttons/secondary-button/index.html): A tonal secondary-surface button for frequent, lower-stakes actions — lower emphasis than solid, higher than outline or ghost. Good for repeated toolbar controls. Tags: button, react, tailwind, secondary, tonal, toolbar, action.
- [Segmented Button](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Buttons/segmented-button/index.html): A joined single-choice control that behaves like a radiogroup: one selected option at a time. Use for 2–5 mutually exclusive options in compact toolbars. Tags: button, react, tailwind, segmented, radiogroup, selection, toggle, interactive.
- [Solid Button](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Buttons/solid-button/index.html): The primary, high-emphasis action. A filled neutral surface built on color.primary and color.primary-foreground — the canonical confirmation control in the DevSnips React system. Tags: button, react, tailwind, primary, action, interactive, form.
- [Sort Button](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Buttons/sort-button/index.html): Sets the sort field and direction. Clicking toggles direction (desc → asc → none → desc). The active sort is shown via the field label + a rotated chevron, not color alone. `aria-label` conveys the current state. Tags: button, react, tailwind, sort, table, toolbar, utility, interactive.
- [Split Button](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Buttons/split-button/index.html): A primary action paired with an attached, keyboard-navigable menu of alternatives. The leading button fires the default action; the chevron opens a menu. A shared border and negative margin keep it one composite control. Tags: button, react, tailwind, split, menu, composite, interactive, action.
- [Sticky Action Button](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Buttons/sticky-action-button/index.html): A persistent primary CTA that sticks to the bottom of the viewport with a hairline top border and a translucent surface so content scrolls beneath. Use for the single primary action on long forms or review screens. Tags: button, react, tailwind, sticky, cta, persistent, composite, interactive.
- [Success Button](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Buttons/success-button/index.html): A positive-emphasis action for confirm, publish, approve, and complete flows. Contextual only — not a replacement for the primary action. Tags: button, react, tailwind, success, confirm, approve, publish, interactive.
- [Toggle Button](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Buttons/toggle-button/index.html): A single binary switch. Controlled via `pressed`, or uncontrolled via `defaultPressed`. Exposes `aria-pressed` and swaps to `surface-active` when on so the state is conveyed by more than color alone. Tags: button, react, tailwind, toggle, aria-pressed, selection, interactive.
- [Toggle Group](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Buttons/toggle-group/index.html): A joined set of toggles. `type="single"` behaves like a radiogroup (one on); `type="multiple"` like a group of checkboxes. Selected segments use `surface-active` + `aria-pressed`, with arrow-key roving. Tags: button, react, tailwind, toggle-group, selection, multi-select, interactive.
- [Calendar](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Calendar/calendar/index.html): The canonical compound calendar: a WAI-ARIA grid of real day buttons with roving-tabindex keyboard navigation, month/year picker views, locale-aware labels, and local-calendar-date semantics — shown here as an uncontrolled single-date calendar. Tags: calendar, date, react, tailwind, accessible, keyboard, grid, responsive, interactive, single-date, uncontrolled.
- [Calendar — Controlled State](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Calendar/calendar-controlled/index.html): A fully parent-controlled calendar: the visible month, the selected date, and even the locale live in parent state, with external month/year/locale selectors and an event log of every callback. Tags: calendar, date, react, tailwind, accessible, keyboard, grid, responsive, interactive, controlled, month, locale, state.
- [Calendar — Disabled Dates](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Calendar/calendar-disabled-dates/index.html): Individual disabled dates via a typed matcher: weekends plus a three-day maintenance blackout are unselectable, keyboard-skipped, and exposed as disabled — while the rest of the calendar stays fully interactive. Tags: calendar, date, react, tailwind, accessible, keyboard, grid, responsive, interactive, disabled, matcher, constraints.
- [Calendar — Min / Max Dates](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Calendar/calendar-min-max/index.html): Inclusive minimum and maximum selectable dates: out-of-window days, impossible navigation, and out-of-range month/year picker options are all disabled, across same-month and cross-year windows. Tags: calendar, date, react, tailwind, accessible, keyboard, grid, responsive, interactive, minDate, maxDate, constraints, booking-window.
- [Calendar — Month Picker](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Calendar/calendar-month-picker/index.html): The month-selection view: a 12-month grid opened from the heading (or seeded with defaultView), with year paging, min/max-aware options, and full keyboard navigation — choosing a month lands in its day grid. Tags: calendar, date, react, tailwind, accessible, keyboard, grid, responsive, interactive, month picker, navigation, view.
- [Calendar — Multiple Dates](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Calendar/calendar-multiple/index.html): Toggle-style multi-date selection with immutable updates: each click adds or removes one date, the selection is a plain Date array, and a controlled parent can clear or replace the whole set. Tags: calendar, date, react, tailwind, accessible, keyboard, grid, responsive, interactive, multiple, toggle, immutable.
- [Calendar — Outside Days](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Calendar/calendar-outside-days/index.html): Adjacent-month days rendered at the grid edges: muted but fully interactive, with their real month in the accessible name — selecting one pages the calendar to its month. Tags: calendar, date, react, tailwind, accessible, keyboard, grid, responsive, interactive, outside days, grid, layout.
- [Calendar — Range Selection](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Calendar/calendar-range/index.html): Two-month range selection with a continuous in-range band: click a start, then an end — earlier clicks and disabled-day crossings restart the range predictably (the demo venue holds Aug 15), same-day ranges are supported, and the selection survives month navigation. Tags: calendar, date, react, tailwind, accessible, keyboard, grid, responsive, interactive, range, multi-month.
- [Calendar — Single Date](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Calendar/calendar-single/index.html): Explicit single-date selection, controlled by the parent: the selected date drives a milestone summary, re-selecting the same day is a no-op, and clearing is only possible through the explicit external action. Tags: calendar, date, react, tailwind, accessible, keyboard, grid, responsive, interactive, single-date, controlled.
- [Calendar — Week Numbers](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Calendar/calendar-week-numbers/index.html): ISO-8601 week numbers in a leading, non-interactive rowheader column, paired with a Monday week start — the standard layout for sprint and capacity planning. - [Calendar — Footer Actions](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Calendar/calendar-with-footer/index.html): A calendar with a footer region: a live selected-date summary plus explicit Clear and Today actions, composed with CalendarFooter and the useCalendar hook. Tags: calendar, date, react, tailwind, accessible, keyboard, grid, responsive, interactive, footer, actions, today, clear.
- [Calendar — Year Picker](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Calendar/calendar-year-picker/index.html): The year-selection view: a 12-year page grid with decade paging and min/max-aware options — choosing a year continues to the month picker, then the day grid. Tags: calendar, date, react, tailwind, accessible, keyboard, grid, responsive, interactive, year picker, navigation, view.
- [Card](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Cards/card/index.html): The reference card: a restrained content surface (radius-md, 1px border, shadow-xs) with the header / content / footer region primitives. Every other variant in the family is built from these same primitives. Tags: card, surface, react, tailwind, accessible, responsive, tokens, reference, compound, composition.
- [Horizontal Card](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Cards/card-horizontal/index.html): A responsive horizontal card: media in a fixed left column with content beside it from `sm` up, collapsing to a top banner + stacked content below `sm`. - [Interactive Card](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Cards/card-interactive/index.html): A card that is itself the interactive element — without the fake-`<div>` anti-pattern. With `href` it renders a real anchor (navigation); without `href` it renders a real `<button type="button">` (actions). Discriminated-union typing keeps the two modes apart. Controlled and uncontrolled modes both supported. Tags: card, surface, react, tailwind, accessible, responsive, tokens, selectable, radio, checkbox, fieldset, keyboard.

Tags: table, data-table, react, tailwind, accessible, responsive, tokens, empty-state, zero-data, action.
- [Expandable Table](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Tables/table-expandable/index.html): A table with expandable rows: a real toggle button per row (aria-expanded + aria-controls), an associated detail panel rendered as a real spanning row, instant reduced-motion-safe toggling, and multiple rows open at once. - [Hoverable Table](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Tables/table-hover/index.html): A table whose row hover treatment is a deliberate affordance: a restrained surface shift that tracks the pointer across the full row, never hides or reveals content, and degrades to nothing on touch — every fact and control stays visible and operable without it. Tags: table, data-table, react, tailwind, accessible, responsive, tokens, hover, row-hover, affordance, touch-safe.

Tags: tooltip, react, tailwind, accessible, keyboard, hover, focus, responsive, interactive, disabled, states.
- [Tooltip Placement](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Tooltips/tooltip-placement/index.html): The full placement matrix through props — side × align on one shared core — plus the viewport correction: a trigger at the page edge flips its tooltip instead of overflowing. Tags: tooltip, react, tailwind, accessible, keyboard, hover, focus, responsive, interactive, placement, positioning.
- [Tooltip with Rich Content](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Tooltips/tooltip-rich-content/index.html): Structured — still non-interactive — content: a title row, supporting metadata, a status dot, or a keyboard-shortcut chip, composed with plain markup inside TooltipContent. Tags: tooltip, react, tailwind, accessible, keyboard, hover, focus, responsive, interactive, rich content, structured, shortcut.
- [Tooltip with Icon Trigger](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Tooltips/tooltip-with-icon/index.html): Icon-only toolbar buttons: every trigger carries a real aria-label (the accessible name), and the tooltip makes that name visible on hover or focus — the standard pattern for toolbars and action rows. Tags: tooltip, react, tailwind, accessible, keyboard, hover, focus, responsive, interactive, icon, toolbar.
- [Tooltip with Long Content](https://devsnips.dev/React/Components/Tooltips/tooltip-with-long-content/index.html): Multi-sentence explanations that stay readable: the bubble wraps at a 16rem measure, caps itself to the viewport on small screens, and keeps the arrow aligned after any correction. Tags: tooltip, react, tailwind, accessible, keyboard, hover, focus, responsive, interactive, long content, wrapping.

### Templates
- [SPRAY — Art School](https://devsnips.dev/React/Templates/spray-art-school/index.html): A premium four-page React + TypeScript template for SPRAY, a fictional street-art school where beginners learn graffiti, sketching, muralism, and stencil work from working artists. A raw DIY-zine visual language — Anton + Space Grotesk type, ink-black surfaces with neon-green and hot-pink accents, torn-paper dividers, spray-splatter decorations, a film-grain noise overlay, and Framer Motion reveal animations. Four route pages (home, work, about, contact) compose reusable typed sections and data (hero, selected work, courses, about, process roadmap, testimonials, CTA, footer) over react-router, Vite build, no external image assets.
